# coolify_integration_token (Data Source)

Reads one Coolify integration token. Requires Coolify >= v4.6.0. The secret and metadata are not returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_integration_token" "cloudflare" {
  uuid = coolify_integration_token.cloudflare.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `uuid` (String) Integration token UUID.

### Read-Only

- `automatic_dns` (Boolean) Cloudflare only. Whether Coolify creates DNS records for new domains.
- `capabilities` (List of String) Capabilities Coolify stored for this token.
- `created_at` (String) When Coolify created the token.
- `dns_zones_count` (Number) Number of Cloudflare DNS zones Coolify could read.
- `integration_provider` (String) Integration provider. Coolify's API field is provider.
- `name` (String) Name of the integration token.
- `proxied_dns` (Boolean) Cloudflare only. Whether new DNS records are proxied.
- `updated_at` (String) When Coolify last updated the token.
- `zones_synced_at` (String) When Cloudflare zones were last read.
